Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated in the initial analysis that "Bad Day at Black Rock: Director is John Sturges; death year 2002." This is a factual error. John Sturges died in 1992, not 2002. This incorrect premise led the subsequent agents to search for confirmation of a non-existent 2002 death year, causing confusion and delaying the correct identification of the death years (Joannon 1996 vs. Sturges 1992) until later in the conversation.
